name: sentinel-v2
description: Sentinel V2 — orquesta front/ (Flutter) + back/ (Node/TS). Ver docs/architecture.md.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix back install && cd front && flutter pub get
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n back,web "npm --prefix back run dev" "cd front && flutter run -d chrome"
scripts.dev:android: node scripts/set-lan-ip.js && concurrently -k -n back,app "npm --prefix back run dev" "cd front && flutter run -d android"
scripts.build:apk: node scripts/set-lan-ip.js && cd front && flutter build apk --release
